acceptance: pyproject.toml defines optional extra native-datagen = ["tpcgen-cli==<pin>"] with hashes pinned in uv.lock; core benchbox installs cleanly without native-datagen and stays py3-none-any.

benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --scale 1 --datagen-backend native and tpcds pass Gate A and Gate B end-to-end: SHA-256 delimited byte parity (--num-threads 1 and default), bidirectional DuckDB EXCEPT ALL zero-row Parquet parity, secondary single-engine query-digest check on the Parquet path (result_digest.py), and TPC-DS NULL/empty-string/encoding parity under --compat c.

All 7 derived TPC consumers validate cleanly on native-generated base data: local smoke suites for tpchavoc, read_primitives, write_primitives, transaction_primitives, datavault, and tpcds_obt, plus datagen/dry-run verification for ai_primitives.

Required path-filtered CI check runs Gate A and Gate B on PRs touching the adapter, TPC generators, or tpcgen-cli pin (SF 0.01/0.1 on PRs; SF 1/10 on pin bumps), and Gate D measurement under make heavy-run meets the ADR budget.

Legacy default runs are untouched, no binary in benchbox/_binaries/ is removed, and requesting --datagen-backend native on Windows arm64 or without native-datagen fails loudly with an actionable message.
context: Phase 1 exit deliverable of the faster data-generation plan. Accelerates TPC-H and TPC-DS (and their 7 derived benchmark consumers: tpchavoc, read_primitives, write_primitives, transaction_primitives, ai_primitives, datavault, tpcds_obt) via upstream tpcgen-cli behind opt-in --datagen-backend native without introducing a new Rust repository.
description:
## Problem
TPC-H and TPC-DS (plus their derived benchmarks) currently rely exclusively on bundled per-OS C dbgen/dsdgen binaries. Upstream datafusion-contrib/tpcgen-rs publishes prebuilt tpcgen-cli wheels on PyPI that can accelerate all 10 TPC-backed benchmarks in parallel without creating a new Rust repository.

## Change
- Add optional extra native-datagen = ["tpcgen-cli==<pin>"] in pyproject.toml with exact version and wheel hashes pinned in uv.lock (via uv lock / uv add --optional).
- Implement a subprocess adapter for tpch and tpcds (--compat c) behind --datagen-backend native, invoking tpcgen-cli across the same execution boundary used by dbgen/dsdgen today.
- Normalize trailing-pipe framing (reusing normalize_tbl_trailing_delimiters or single-pass streaming pipe if confirmed by datagen-p0-tpcgen-parity-spike) and chunk file naming (<table>.tbl.<n>.zst etc.) so loaders and all derived benchmarks see an identical layout.
- Support opt-in direct tpcgen-cli Parquet output recorded in data_generation_hash while keeping BenchBox's streaming Parquet converter as default for Parquet runs.
- Preserve _generation_in_progress markers, atomic renames, and Python-only DataGenerationManifest emission; keep C dbgen/dsdgen intact for refresh sets (RF1/RF2, TPC-DS updates) and unsupported platforms (Windows arm64).
- Add required path-filtered CI checks (Gates A, B, D) triggered on PRs touching the adapter, TPC generators, or tpcgen-cli pin: SF 0.01/0.1 on PRs, SF 1/10 on pin bumps; SHA-256 delimited parity, DuckDB EXCEPT ALL Parquet parity, TPC-DS NULL/empty-string/encoding checks, and derived-benchmark smoke suites (tpchavoc, read_primitives, write_primitives, transaction_primitives, datavault, tpcds_obt).

## Decision gates
- If datagen-p0-tpcgen-parity-spike identified a blocking parity gap on tpcds (or a specific scale), wire only the verified benchmark(s) behind native and leave the unverified benchmark blocked with an explicit error until fixed upstream.
- Stop and report if any derived benchmark smoke suite fails on native-generated base data.

## Guardrails
- Keep legacy as the default backend for tpch and tpcds in this item.
- Never remove any binary from benchbox/_binaries/ (dbgen/dsdgen stay for refresh sets, Windows arm64, and legacy fallback; qgen/dsqgen/templates always stay).
- Never create a perpetual non-blocking nightly job; parity tests run as required path-filtered PR/pin-bump CI checks.
- Core benchbox remains py3-none-any; native-datagen stays optional.
- Follow AGENTS.md ([COMMENT-POLICY-001], [HEAVY-LOCK-001], [RUN-DATA-001], linked worktree, make pr-preflight, merged PR).
